Metadata.version_note: v2.0 adds: verification matrix, telemetry spec, test harness designs, failure packet format, autonomy gap assessment. v2.1: autonomy readiness updated to reflect implemented codebase. v2.2: M-020 HTTP transport added. v2.3: AgentMemBank UX, Directory Contract, membank_init, process logging and read-only admin dashboard contracts added. v2.4: write_note/create_note diff requirement, dry_run bypass detection and M-020 transport test contract hardened. v2.5: full verification run complete — 345 tests (343 passed, 2 skipped), all 9 phase gates PG-001..PG-009 pass, static boundaries intact, autonomy readiness confirmed READY for all 28 modules M-001..M-028. v2.6: adds M-029 EmbeddingService, V-M-029, PH-010 (SemanticRetrievalActivation), PH-011 (ProcessEventAndAuditIntegration), DF-014, DF-015, extended V-M-010 for hybrid search, V-M-027 for audit UNION, V-M-028 for admin_db wiring fix.

GlobalPolicy.rule: Every module must have module-local tests matching its MODULE_CONTRACT.
Every critical flow must have at least one integration-level scenario.
Every mutation test must verify dry-run, diff, revision recheck, audit event and affected_paths.
Every path-facing test must include traversal, denylist and symlink rejection cases.
Every retrieval response must be policy-filtered even when index contents are stale.
Any stop condition failure blocks further execution until architecture or contracts are revised.
Deterministic assertions first; trace assertions second; semantic evaluation only when exact asserts are insufficient.
Every log entry from a critical block must include trace_id, module, function, and BLOCK_NAME marker.
Secrets, API keys, credentials must be redacted from all log output. Redaction is tested.
Module-level verification must complete in under 30s for worker-loop viability.

field.name: data
field.required: optional — structured payload; never raw secrets

MarkerConvention.rule: Every critical log must include a BLOCK_NAME matching its semantic block tag in source.

RedactionRules.rule: API key values — log only key_id fingerprint (first 4 chars + last 4 chars).
Vault file content — never log full content; log content_hash and byte_count.
Credentials in config — never log raw config; log sanitized summary only.
Patch/diff content — log operation type and affected_heading; never full body in prod.
Secrets (private/, secrets/ paths) — log only that a denied path was referenced, not the path literal if it contains secret names.

legend.evidence_type: DETERMINISTIC — exact assert on return value, state, or hash
TRACE — assert required/forbidden markers and order in captured logs
INTEGRATION — end-to-end viability across module boundaries
SEMANTIC — rubric-based evaluation of traces (only when DET/TRACE insufficient)

Records process events at server startup, tool registration, request.received, request.completed and request.failed via M-025.

FlowVerification.name: SafeMutation
FlowVerification.must_verify: dry-run, constrained patch, lock, external sync recheck, atomic write, diff generation for ALL operations (create/append/edit/write), audit, affected_paths
FlowVerification.success_scenario: append_note succeeds, diff is generated, audit event is written, LOG.md projection is updated and affected_paths contains changed note.
edit_note with replace_exact_block succeeds only when expected_revision matches current sha256(content).
write_note generates unified diff via prepare_change and returns diff in MutationResult.
create_note generates full-file-addition diff via prepare_change and returns diff in MutationResult.
FlowVerification.failure_scenario: edit_note without dry_run is rejected.
External sync changes file between plan and write; mutation returns conflict and does not overwrite.
Free-form regex patch is rejected.
write_note or create_note called with dry_run=False bypasses policy if _authorize_or_raise hardcodes dry_run=True.
FlowVerification.forbidden_trace: TA-011 directly after TA-010 from M-008 (must go through M-001); TA-003 missing before TA-007 for any mutation

StopCondition.condition: Any write path bypasses M-003 VaultPolicyGuard or M-006 ChangePlanner.
StopCondition.detection: Call-graph trace missing TA-002 or TA-004 before TA-007.
StopCondition.action: Stop implementation and replan mutation boundary.

StopCondition.condition: M-008 VaultMutationService directly calls M-014 IndexRefreshService.
StopCondition.detection: Static import check: M-008 import graph contains M-014.

StopCondition.condition: Concurrent write or external sync test can silently overwrite a newer content hash.
StopCondition.detection: TA-006b never emitted but file changed; or write succeeds with mismatched revision.

StopCondition.condition: Any retrieval response exposes denylisted content or metadata.
StopCondition.detection: SearchResult contains path from denylist without TA-014 emitted.
StopCondition.action: Stop and redesign indexing/query response filtering.

StopCondition.condition: Any symlink path or parent component is accepted in MVP.
StopCondition.detection: TA-018 never emitted for symlink test fixture.

StopCondition.condition: Wiki update mutates 70_Wiki without propose-only diff review.
Index is treated as source of truth instead of rebuildable derivative.
StopCondition.detection: Search or refresh reads from index without verifying against Vault content.

StopCondition.condition: Agent-facing write destination is inferred from folder names instead of Directory Contract.
StopCondition.detection: Test shows generic or structured write targets deprecated alias, unknown top-level folder, or missing canonical key without policy rejection.
StopCondition.action: Stop and redesign Directory Contract enforcement in M-022/M-003/M-001.

StopCondition.condition: Logs, dashboard or .log reports expose secrets, raw note content, raw patch bodies or denylisted content.
StopCondition.detection: Redaction tests find API key, admin password, Authorization header, raw note body or private/secrets content in outputs.
StopCondition.action: Stop and fix redaction before continuing admin observability work.

StopCondition.condition: Admin dashboard provides or triggers Vault mutation, rollback, delete or direct filesystem access.
StopCondition.detection: Static boundary check finds M-028 -> M-005/M-009 or integration trace emits TA-007 from admin route.
StopCondition.action: Stop and restore read-only admin dashboard boundary.

StopCondition.condition: Embedding API key or raw request content appears in logs, dashboard, or error traces.
StopCondition.detection: Redaction test finds API key value, Authorization header, or raw chunk text in M-029 log output.
StopCondition.action: Stop and fix redaction in M-029 before any vector operations.

StopCondition.condition: Vector search returns results inconsistent with FTS, or hybrid search drops FTS matches when vector returns fewer results.
StopCondition.detection: Integration test with known-content fixtures shows hybrid results ⊇ FTS results.
StopCondition.action: Stop and fix result union/merging logic in M-010.search_notes.

StopCondition.condition: sqlite-vec unavailable in deployed environment but server crashes instead of degrading to FTS.
StopCondition.detection: M-016.create_vector_adapter('sqlite_vec') returns NoopVectorAdapter without raising exception; retrieval still returns FTS results.
StopCondition.action: Stop and fix sqlite-vec import handling in M-016.

FailurePacket.description: When verification fails, produce a packet with these fields so another agent can continue without guessing.

fields.field: Module contract or flow ref that failed (e.g., M-003, VF-DF-002)
Specific scenario that failed (e.g., M-003-F-001, VF-DF-002-S-001)
What the contract/scenario requires (values, markers, behaviors)
What actually happened (actual values, actual trace, actual markers)
Semantic block where divergence occurred (if applicable)
Correlation ID for the failed execution
Concrete next step (e.g., "re-check M-003 denylist regex", "add missing revision recheck in M-007.recheck_revision")
Exact command to reproduce the failure

usage_flow.step: 1. Worker or phase gate runs verification command
2. Verification fails → capture trace_id, scenario ref, divergence
4. Hand off to a remediation agent (grace-fix) or to developer with full context

TestHarnessDesign.description: Concrete test file structures for Phase 1 (FoundationAndPolicy). Designed for pytest + pytest-asyncio. Every test file is source-adjacent (tests/ mirrors src/memory_mcp/).

fixture.name: temp_vault_root
fixture.desc: Creates isolated tmp_path with subdirs: memory/, inbox/, summaries/, 70_Wiki/, private/, .obsidian/, .git/ and sample .md files.

fixture.name: temp_sqlite
fixture.desc: Creates in-memory SQLite DB with WAL mode. Yields connection; closes after test.

fixture.name: sample_config_dict
fixture.desc: Returns a valid config dict with all sections populated. Tests mutate individual fields to trigger failure scenarios.

fixture.name: log_capture
fixture.desc: Caplog fixture configured for structured JSON output capture. Returns list of parsed log entries.

fixture.name: trace_assert
fixture.desc: Helper that takes caplog records and asserts markers appeared in expected order, forbidden markers absent.

scenario.name: test_load_valid_config_returns_typed_settings
scenario.then: ServerConfig object with typed fields; TA-019 emitted

scenario.name: test_missing_vault_root_fails_closed
scenario.then: ConfigError raised; TA-020 emitted; service init blocked

scenario.name: test_secrets_not_present_in_sanitized_log
scenario.when: config loaded and sanitized summary emitted
scenario.then: raw API key values not in log output; only key_id fingerprints

scenario.name: test_log_trace_anchor_emits_structured_json
scenario.then: JSON output with all required fields: timestamp, level, trace_id, module, function, block, event

scenario.name: test_error_codes_cover_auth_policy_fs_patch_revision_audit_failures
scenario.then: has entries: AUTH_INVALID_KEY, AUTH_UNKNOWN_KEY, POLICY_DENIED, FS_PATH_TRAVERSAL, FS_SYMLINK_DENIED, PATCH_INVALID, PATCH_UNSUPPORTED, REVISION_MISMATCH, LOCK_TIMEOUT, AUDIT_WRITE_FAILED, INDEX_CORRUPT, CONFIG_INVALID

scenario.name: test_redaction_removes_api_key_from_log
scenario.then: log output contains "sk-s...1234" or equivalent redacted form; raw key absent

scenario.name: test_valid_api_key_resolves_to_agent_identity
scenario.given: known API key "test-key-readonly-001" mapped to readonly_agent profile

scenario.name: test_invalid_api_key_returns_error_and_emits_rejected
scenario.then: AuthError with error_code AUTH_UNKNOWN_KEY; TA-001b emitted

scenario.name: test_api_key_value_never_logged
scenario.then: captured log output does not contain raw API key; only key_id fingerprint

scenario.name: test_all_five_profiles_map_from_config
scenario.then: returns readonly_agent, trusted_writer, wiki_maintainer, cron_summarizer, admin profiles

scenario.name: test_expired_or_revoked_key_rejected
scenario.given: API key marked revoked in config

scenario.name: test_symlink_path_rejected_by_policy
scenario.given: path points to symlink; even before M-005 checks

scenario.name: test_filter_search_results_removes_denylisted_entries
scenario.then: results contain only "memory/ok.md" and "inbox/draft.md"; TA-014 emitted for filtered

scenario.name: test_full_profile_tool_permission_matrix
scenario.then: matrix matches expected permissions from technology.xml profiles

scenario.name: test_atomic_write_uses_temp_then_rename
scenario.then: temp file created, content written, renamed to target; TA-007 emitted; no partial file visible

Level.name: module
Level.scope: Single module, its own test file, its own dependencies mocked
Level.commands: typecheck + lint + unit tests (pytest single test file)
Level.evidence: Deterministic assertions + trace assertions on module-local logs
Level.trigger: After every code change, pre-commit, worker loop iteration

Level.name: wave
Level.scope: All modules touched in current wave, integration tests for merged surfaces
Level.commands: pytest on all wave test files + relevant flow integration tests
Level.evidence: Integration trace assertions checking inter-module marker order
Level.trigger: After completing a wave of module implementations

Level.name: phase
Level.scope: All modules in current and prior phases, full flow verifications
Level.commands: Full test suite for all implemented phases + autonomy gate check
Level.evidence: Stop condition validations, full traceability matrix, autonomy readiness report
Level.trigger: Before marking a phase complete; before enabling autonomous multi-phase execution
